title: Aromatic Mediterranean Chuck Roast Stew
description: A garlicky, velvety stew that brings Mediterranean flavors to the table with tender chuck roast, fresh herbs, and a rich tomato base. Perfect for a comforting lunch or dinner.
instructions: Heat the hot‑pot vessel over medium‑high heat and add 2 tablespoons of olive oil.
Season the chuck roast with salt and pepper; sear it on all sides until browned, about 4 minutes per side, then remove and set aside.
In the same pot, add the diced onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables soften, about 5 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for an additional minute until fragrant.
Stir in the tomato paste, coating the vegetables, and cook for 2 minutes to develop flavor.
Pour in the cup of red wine to deglaze the pot, scraping up browned bits; simmer until the wine reduces by half, about 5 minutes.
Return the roast to the pot and add the 3 cups of beef broth and the herb sprigs; bring the mixture to a gentle simmer.
Cover the pot, reduce heat to low, and let the stew cook for 1 hour and 45 minutes, or until the meat is tender.
Remove the herb sprigs and stir in extra salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
